book.totem.manual.getting_started.title: Totem Starter Guide
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.1:
WELCOME

This starter guide is yours to keep. Each Totem module has a source block that records its own method guide.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.2:
DISCOVER

Craft a module's first block. Its advancement tells you which block to record next.
book.totem.manual.getting_started.page.3:
RECORD

Use this guide, another Totem guide, or a plain book on that block. A generated guide is never consumed; a plain book becomes the new module guide.
